entities.name: users
entities.invariants: SSO subject unique; local pilot identity is limited to mock mode

entities.name: projects
entities.invariants: Only approved project profile revisions executable

entities.name: jobs
entities.fields: job_id, owner_id, project_id, workflow_id, status, revision, cycle
entities.invariants: owner from authentication, never request payload

entities.name: step_runs
entities.fields: step_run_id, job_id, step_id, cycle, attempt, state, execution_id
entities.invariants: UNIQUE(job_id, step_id, cycle, attempt); prior attempts immutable

entities.name: execution_plans
entities.invariants: Plan changes produce new immutable versions

entities.name: candidate_manifests
entities.fields: candidate_id, job_id, source_commit, config_hash, toolchain_hash, image_hash

entities.name: artifacts
entities.fields: artifact_id, job_id, kind, sha256, size, uri, mode, candidate_id
entities.invariants: No path from browser used as arbitrary filesystem path

entities.name: trace_links
entities.fields: requirement_id, feature_id, srs_id, sdd_id, code_ref, tc_id, result_id

entities.name: human_tasks
entities.fields: task_id, job_id, step_run_id, assignee_id, outcome, evidence_ids

entities.name: gate_results
entities.fields: gate_id, step_run_id, candidate_id, verdict, rule_version, evidence_ids

entities.name: release_manifests
entities.fields: manifest_id, job_id, digest, candidate_id, destination, notes_hash
entities.invariants: Destination and evidence bundle included in digest

entities.name: approvals
entities.invariants: Approval bound to manifest; revoked or stale never usable

entities.name: release_actions
entities.fields: action_id, manifest_id, kind, idempotency_key, state, remote_ref

entities.name: bridge_devices
entities.fields: device_id, owner_id, bridge_id, serial_map, board_id, state
entities.invariants: One registered identity maps ADB/fastboot modes

entities.name: device_leases
entities.fields: device_id, lease_id, job_id, fencing_token, expires_at, state
entities.invariants: Unique active lease per device; unknown quarantined

entities.name: device_commands
entities.fields: command_id, lease_id, action, profile_hash, state, result_ref

entities.name: events
entities.fields: event_id, job_id, step_run_id, source_id, source_seq, type, payload

consistency: Temporal is authoritative for process transitions. PostgreSQL stores command inbox/outbox, immutable evidence and query projections. Workflow transitions project through idempotent activities. API 202 is not final success.
authorization: Every query/download checks project membership and job ownership/delegated role. Internal workers/bridge tokens additionally scoped to assignments.
transactions: Submit command and outbox record atomically
Claim device with row lock and increment fencing token
Persist artifact only after hash/size verified
Record release receipt before advancing final state
